articles.title: Euro Leagues - Alvarez to Arsenal? Plus Muslić on Schalke - BBC Sounds
articles.summary: Is Alvarez set for Arsenal? & Schalke boss Muslić chats about Dzeko & Karius' redemption.
articles.body:
Radio 5 Live , · 26 Aug 2026 , · 49 mins

Maz Farookhi is joined by ESPN's Julien Laurens and German football expert Rafa Honigstein for this week's Euro Leagues. The team reflect on a turbulent week for Julian Alvarez at Atletico Madrid, and with Barcelona seemingly out of the running, does that open the door for Arsenal? Then, we hear more about Musiala's condition which saw him collapse in consecutive friendlies for Bayern last week. How have the club kept it private for such a long time, and is there a long-term concern over Musiala's career? Schalke and ex-Plymouth Argyle head coach Miron Muslić joins the pod to discuss Schalke's promotion to the Bundesliga, the signing of fellow Bosnian Edin Džeko, and how Loris Karius has turned his career around at the club. Finally, Jules and Raf look at who might be best-placed to challenge Bayern domestically this season. How have they improved the squad? 27:18 Miron Muslić on Schalke's return to the Bundesliga 29:30 How did Miron's time at Plymouth shape him? 33:09 Loris Karius' career redemption 35:05 Signing Edin Dzeko at 39 years old 40:13 Can anyone challenge Bayern this season?

articles.title: Nicolas Jackson transfer: Aston Villa agree deal worth up to £65m to sign Chelsea striker
articles.summary: Aston Villa agree deal worth up to £65m to sign Chelsea forward Nicolas Jackson, matching Blues' valuation; Jackson had spent last season on loan at Bayern Munich;
articles.body:
The deal for Watkins is understood to be worth £50m, with Jackson set to join from the Blues in a transfer which could reach £65m.

Watkins is keen on the move to Saudi Arabia, and at least one bid was previously rejected by Villa. They did not want to sell the England international, but have now accepted Al Hilal's latest offer.

Chelsea's plan all summer has been to sell Jackson and Liam Delap. Atletico Madrid also want Jackson, but may not be able to offer as much as Villa. Jackson worked with Villa manager Unai Emery when they were both at Villarreal.

Jackson, who joined Chelsea from Villarreal in 2023, spent last season on loan at Bayern Munich.

The Bundesliga champions had an obligation to buy the forward included in the deal worth £56.25m, but Jackson did not reach the number of appearances required to exercise the option.

articles.title: Dark horse teams that could make run at College Football Playoff during 2026 season
articles.summary: These teams are suited for more than just pulling a midseason upset.
articles.body:
In its current form, the College Football Playoff affords space for some surprises. A second loss isn't the nail in the coffin it used to be, and every team — even those outside the power conferences — can trace a path to the 12-team field.

The playoff will inevitably expand, but, for now, a place in the bracket is equal parts coveted and achievable. That balance has set the stage for some iconic dark horses to emerge on a yearly basis.

Here are five that could dash into the CFP conversation this year: one from each Power Four conference and a fifth representing the Group of Six.

Jeff Brohm has won 28 games in three seasons at Louisville. Year 4 could be the breakthrough where the program finally barges into the CFP. That largely hinges on the play of transfer quarterback Lincoln Kienholz, a three-sport high school superstar from Pierre, South Dakota, who arrived at Ohio State with tantalizing athleticism but a ways to go technically. Since, he's learned under the likes of Chip Kelly and Ryan Day. Now Louisville's expected starter, Kienholz will likely have a chance to showcase the growth he's made. His dual-threat ability, combined with an awesome supporting cast that includes the Cardinals' latest batch of transfers, could deliver plenty of excitement and wins.

Brohm has aced the portal early in his stay at Louisville. He's earned trust in that department. So even though he has another team bursting at the seams with transplants, that can be easily viewed through the positive lens of red-colored glasses. QB1 will be sticking the ball in the bellies of Isaac Brown and Keyjuan Brown. They rushed for 884 and 704 yards, respectively, during the 2025 campaign. Both Browns posted at least 7.3 yards per carry. The receiver room features new yet proven names. Tre Richardson is coming off a seven-touchdown season with Vanderbilt, and he also averaged 25.1 yards on kickoff returns. Keep an eye on former Tulsa tight end Brody Foley, too. He reeled in 37 passes for 528 yards and seven scores last time around. Up front, the interior presence of Lance Robinson and Eryx Daugherty, a newcomer from Boston College, should help fortify the unit.

Defensive end Clev Lubin racked up 8.5 sacks and forced three fumbles last season. He's back for more. On the opposite side is AJ Green, a 6-foot-6, 250-pounder who's a backfield wrecker in his own right. There are notable returners in the other two levels of the defense as well. Antonio Watts is a playmaker at nickel, with a team-leading three interceptions and a pair of sacks justifying that reputation last season. He was part of a top-25 pass defense in 2025. The secondary will be leaning on transfers at the safety position, including Koen Entringer from Iowa. But there's a lot to like for co-coordinators Steve Ellis and Mark Ivey.

The neutral-site season opener against Ole Miss will be a litmus test, and the Cardinals' ACC opener versus SMU could be a similar gut check. The road gets a lot easier after that, however: no Notre Dame, Miami or Clemson.

Noah Fifita already owns the record for the most passing touchdowns in Wildcats history. He won't sniff the all-time NCAA record in that category . That said, he can still reach the century mark, a remarkable feat in itself. Fifita enters 2026 with 73 scoring strikes through the air. Last season, Brent Brennan's second as head coach, Fifita posted an impressive 29:6 touchdown-to-interception ratio. Although he lost his top-two receivers, it's necessary to underscore how he spread the ball around in 2025.

In fact, Tré Spivey, who ranked third on the Wildcats in receiving yards, wound up with a team-high seven touchdown grabs. Offensive coordinator Seth Doege will be counting on continued progress from the 6-foot-4 wideout. Similarly, Chris Hunter will have to step up. He was third on Arizona's receptions leaderboard with 27 a season ago. Factor in Illinois transfer tight end Cole Rusk, Marshall transfer running back Antwan Roberts and some offensive line experience — heightened by the addition of Washington center Zach Henning — and you have a unit capable of launching some Big 12 fireworks.

Defense can be hard to come by in the conference. Arizona fielded a mighty fine one last season. With Danny Gonzales coordinating the group, the Wildcats finished fourth in the league in fewest points per game allowed (19.3) and second in fewest yards per play given up (4.67). Plus, the only team in the country that forced more turnovers than Arizona (31) in 2025 was Texas Tech (32). Replicating takeaway totals from year-to-year is always tricky. At least for the Wildcats, they've brought back several defenders who saw the field last season. Chase Kennedy is looking to build on a four-sack campaign, and Taye Brown is dependable at the linebacker position, where he amassed 93 total tackles as a junior. Arizona notably had to turn to the portal at safety this offseason. So that's a bit of a question mark going into the season.

So is, most importantly, how the Wildcats will handle the rigor of an unrelenting Big 12 schedule. Their slate is fraught with challenges, including road games against BYU, Texas Tech and Kansas State. Winning one of those would be solid. Taking two could put Brennan's Wildcats in position for something special. Look, there are other dark horse candidates in the Big 12 like K-State and Oklahoma State . In this exercise, though, we're highlighting Arizona, which can log back-to-back winning seasons for the first time since it enjoyed four straight from 2012-15.

Indiana couldn't be classified as a dark horse two seasons ago. The Hoosiers didn't even have a spot in the starting gate ahead of Curt Cignetti's first season at the helm. The program had three winning seasons in the 21st century. A double-digit-win season wasn't part of its DNA. A mutation changed that in 2024, the beginning of one of college sports' most unlikely turnarounds, well, ever. You know how the rest goes.

UCLA isn't the laughingstock Indiana was on the gridiron. Even so, the Bruins needed a facelift after an entropic 2025 campaign that saw them stack their only three victories in a row, in Big Ten play no less. UCLA isn't exactly poised to undergo the same metamorphosis as Indiana this time around — the Hoosiers' Cinderella story is more of a fairytale than it is a blueprint — but there are some Year 1 parallels for head coach Bob Chesney.

Like Cignetti, Chesney joined the conference after a successful stint at James Madison. What's more significant than that resemblance is the fact that both coaches pulled heavily from their JMU staffs and rosters to make up their inaugural power-conference squads. Chesney carried over a collection of players who helped the Dukes win the Sun Belt and crack the CFP field a season ago. Headlining that cohort are running back Wayne Knight (1,770 scrimmage yards and 10 total touchdowns in 2025), wide receiver Landon Ellis (624 receiving yards and five receiving touchdowns in 2025), defensive end Sahir West (seven sacks in 2025) and nickel DJ Barksdale (12 passes defended in 2025).

Chesney's newest quarterback, Nico Iamaleava, has played in the CFP before. Granted, that was when he was part of a Tennessee team that relied on a robust defense, but he's a former five-star recruit who has yet to fully realize his potential. Maybe Chesney can get him to maximize his versatile skill set. Chesney has won everywhere he's gone amid his voyage through the collegiate ranks, from Division III Salve Regina to Division II Assumption to FCS Holy Cross to JMU. No wonder an influx of transfer portal talent has followed him, and not just from his former school. Linebacker Sammy Omosigho, previously at Oklahoma, and former Utah safety Tao Johnson also come to mind. The key to a rapid ascent at UCLA? A favorable schedule. The Bruins have one. They dodge Ohio State and Indiana. A loss to Oregon on the road is likely. But there are an assortment of winnable games, and if they swipe one of two from Michigan and USC, things could get interesting.

There are a few SEC schools in the dark horse bucket this season. Florida and South Carolina are due for rebounds and could be filed into this category. But we think Auburn can reverse its recent misfortune and make a run at a CFP bid. The Tigers haven't won more than six games in a season since 2019. They've lost 12 of their past 13 one-score contests. They needed another reset, and that's where Alex Golesh comes in. The program's third head coach post-Gus Malzahn, Golesh resuscitated South Florida, which had won a combined four games in the three seasons prior to his arrival. He immediately guided the Bulls to back-to-back seven-victory campaigns, complete with bowl wins, and then oversaw a nine-win splash in 2025 that began with consecutive top-25 wins and paved the way for USF's first-ever appearance in the CFP rankings.

Quarterback Byrum Brown was a big part of that bloom. A powerful runner who can stretch the field with his arm — he completed 30 passes that traveled 20-plus air yards last season, per PFF — Brown authored 42 total touchdowns for USF in 2025. In 2026, he'll be spearheading Golesh's Auburn team. He netted more than 1,000 yards on the ground and threw for more than 3,000 along the way. Brown has the luxury of familiarity on offense, thanks to a receiving room that has USF fingerprints all over it: Keshaun Singleton, Christian Neptune, Jeremiah Koger and Chas Nimrod are all there. Singleton and Koger both hauled in eight TD passes a season ago. Auburn running back Jeremiah Cobb stuck around after nearly hitting the 1,000-yard rushing mark in 2025, and he's accompanied by Baylor transfer Bryson Washington and former USF back Nykahi Davenport. One of many teams rolling the dice in the trenches with a portal rush, Auburn's potential hiccups on the offensive line can be partly alleviated by Brown's mobility.

It's impossible to ignore the change on the defensive side of the ball. A constant is defensive coordinator DJ Durkin. He's been responsible for a pair of top-35 scoring defenses. There's belief he can stitch together a crew that can complement and, at times shoulder the burden of, a fun and fast offense. Linebacker Xavier Atkins is a name to know. He led the Tigers with 84 total tackles and nine sacks last season. Durkin will need guys to step up at cornerback — UCLA transfer Andre Jordan could be one of them — but the back seven/eight as a whole could be a strength. The Tigers' schedule is never easy, and this season is no exception. But a high-octane offense can stir the pot.

Group of Six Dark Horse: New Mexico Lobos

Remember, the winners of the SEC, Big Ten, Big 12 and ACC will clinch a spot in this season's CFP, and the highest-ranked team from the Group of Six, including the new-look Pac-12, will receive a spot in the field, too, even if that G6 team isn't a conference champion. That's a modification from the past two iterations of the playoff, in which the five highest-ranked conference champions, regardless of conference, earned automatic bids.

The Group of Six has been represented by Boise State (2024), JMU (2025) and Tulane (2025) so far in the 12-team CFP. As for who's next, there are an array of options. If the American gets some more representation, maybe Navy rises from the dust of a league decimated by the portal this offseason. It's possible Boise State punches another ticket to the CFP, this time from the Pac-12. And don't rule out North Dakota State, which is eligible for postseason play from the jump after transitioning from the FCS, where it was a powerhouse for years. Let's stay in the Mountain West. That's where New Mexico, my final dark horse, lies.

The Lobos ranked 20th in the final returning production rankings released by ESPN's Bill Connelly . In an era when keeping players put — everywhere but especially in the Group of Six — is incredibly hard, New Mexico retained 68% of the output from an offense that dropped 35 points on UCLA last season and 40 more on UNLV. The Lobos won their final six regular-season games and clocked out 9-4. Now they're constructed to notch their first 10-win season since 1982. They might have to get by early on without quarterback Jack Layne, who's recovering from elbow surgery .

But New Mexico is strapped with returners on the offensive line and can call upon running back Scottre Humphrey, who previously topped the 1,000-yard barrier at FCS Montana State, and newcomers like North Texas transfer Kiefer Sibley, who posted 6.1 yards per carry and found the end zone five times last season. Plus, the Lobos' defense is arguably the pulse of the team. Look no further than the second level. Linebacker Jaxton Eck, the son of head coach Jason Eck, is one of the top defenders in the Mountain West, as evidenced by his 128 total tackles in 2025. New Mexico will be tested on Sept. 19 at Oklahoma. There's a chance the league, and potentially even the G6 CFP bid, comes down to the Lobos and UNLV in the conference championship game.

articles.title: Julian Alvarez: Atletico Madrid say there's 'zero per cent chance' of him joining Barcelona despite club's plea as Arsenal wait in wings
articles.summary: Barcelona president Joan Laporta asked Atletico Madrid to accept their offer for Julian Alvarez on Wednesday; Atleti have responded by saying there is 'zero per cent chance' the Argentina moves to the Camp Nou; Arsenal are also interested in Alvarez
articles.body:
Alvarez did not train with his Atletico team-mates on Wednesday, though this was officially put down to a stomach bug and a poor night's sleep rather than anything to do with his future.

The 26-year-old wants to join Barcelona , who again went public with their desire to sign him on Wednesday in a video interview with president Joan Laporta.

The truth is that we're very interested in the player," he told their club channels. "We'd like our offer to be accepted, and we say this with all due respect for Atletico Madrid."

However, Atletico's stance remains that they categorically do not want to sell him - and even more emphatically that he will not be sold to Barcelona in particular. Not only because the two are rivals, but also due to bad blood between the clubs over previous transfers.

Atletico have not commented directly but Marca , Spain's biggest sports newspaper, have received on-the-record quotes from the club saying: "The player is being portrayed as the victim, but we are the only victims in this case.

"[Barcelona] have harmed us both financially and socially. There is a zero-per-cent chance of selling him to Barcelona - it's not about money, it's about dignity."

The situation around Alvarez's future has become "extremely tense", according to Atletico expert and journalist Ruben Uría.

His public desire to leave has made him so unpopular with the club's supporters that he was booed off after their 2-2 draw with Villarreal on Sunday.

"Neither Miguel Gil Marín (CEO of Atlético Madrid) nor the Apollo board want to sell the player to Barcelona," Uría told Sky Sports News . "The entire Apollo board supports Gil Marín's decision. Alvarez has been told."

According to Uría, Arsenal sporting director Andrea Berta has remained in contact with his former Atletico employers in recent days after Alvarez was booed off by supporters in the opening LaLiga game against Villarreal.

The Gunners remain interested in Alvarez and would be prepared to break their transfer record, the £105m paid out for Declan Rice three summers ago, to bring him to the Emirates Stadium - but the player himself does not want to move to London.

Could Arsenal still end up signing Alvarez?

Sky Sports News senior reporter Rob Dorsett :

"I think even if Arsenal are outsiders at the moment, and the official word is that Arsenal aren't holding out great hopes of making this deal happen.

'But if Alvarez thinks his future needs to be away from Atletico Madrid after upsetting his supporters and they won't sell him to Barcelona, his only option is to join Arsenal, the Premier League champions.

"At the moment, he says he doesn't want to do that. But there are still six days of the window left."

articles.title: Celtic: Another season, another failure - where did it all go wrong?
articles.summary: Celtic have now faltered in Champions League qualifying on six occasions in eight years. What are the ramifications this time?
articles.body:
Six attempts to qualify for the Champions League in the past eight years. Six failures. And a sixth post-mortem for Celtic.

Picking through the wreckage of a European campaign has become almost an August perennial when it comes to the Scottish champions. But few of those failures have been quite so wretched as this one.

Leading 3-0 from the first leg in Glasgow, Celtic took the lead in Austria. Three quarters through the two-legged tie, they still held a three-goal advantage. But then came the collapse.

Ultimately, it took until the 90th minute of the second leg for LASK to level the tie 4-4 on aggregate, but it would be hard to say it wasn't coming after a second-half bombardment in Linz. The hosts' fifth goal - the winner - was inevitable.

Martin O'Neill's side had won all four competitive games to start the season, scoring 13 goals in the process. Everything was rosy. But now the questions are piling up.

Celtic blow four-goal lead to LASK in Champions League collapse

Celtic deficiencies laid bare on another night of Champions League pain

O'Neill takes responsibility after Celtic's latest European capitulation

What's the problem with this Celtic squad?

Captain Callum McGregor said Celtic looked "scared" and were "passive" when LASK launched wave upon wave of attacks as the game went on in Linz.

Benjamin Nygren, Auston Trusty and Luke McCowan all made errors that led directly to concessions and Celtic simply did not compete in midfield.

O'Neill insisted he was responsible, but former Celtic captain Scott Brown believes the manager was just protecting his players.

"I feel for Martin because he's taking full responsibility," Brown told BBC Scotland.

"I've been in Martin's situation. When you get humiliated in a game, you need to take that pressure off the players because in a week's time they've got another game."

Celtic's defence at full-time consisted of third-choice right-back Anthony Ralston, Trusty - who did not train in the build-up because of illness - untested academy product Dane Murray, and Liam Scales out of position at left-back.

Brown says Celtic's depth isn't of the level required to compete in Europe's premier club competition.

"The substitutes aren't Martin's players," he added. "The strength and depth in areas still needs a little bit of quality because the players that came on didn't hit the same level as the ones that went off."

Celtic have bought forwards Kasper Hogh and Camilo Duran for big money this summer, as well as signing midfielder Mika Baur and winger Haissem Hassan.

However, they have sold key players Daizen Maeda and Arne Engels to Ipswich Town and West Ham United, respectively.

Former Celtic striker Chris Sutton questioned the decision to let influential players leave before such a crucial game on social media, while Brown says Engels' absence was a telling factor on the night.

"What they're missing is probably another physical centre-midfielder that can be alongside [McGregor] in there to help him out," he added.

"Because Arne Engels is a huge miss physically, not just for the battle, but his legs and running power as well, getting in behind, but his mentality as well."

How much will Champions League exit cost Celtic?

When Celtic reached the Champions League play-off round before losing to Bayern Munich in 2024/25, their revenue of £143m ranked them among the top 60 clubs in Europe that year.

The same season, Ipswich Town had the lowest revenue of any English Premier League club at £155m. It's perhaps also worth considering, though, that the last published LASK turnover was only £42m.

Football finance expert Kieran Maguire estimates the financial consequences of failing to make it to the Champions League this term will be north of £20m.

"For every £100 generated in the Champions League in terms of prize money, it works out at about £22 in the Europa League and about £11 in the Conference League," Maguire told BBC Sport Scotland.

"Celtic made about £45m in season 2024-25 when they got to the Champions League knockout play-off - that's total prize money, including the SPFL money, but it's still indicative of how successful the competition can be.

"Aston Villa, who won the Europa League last year, probably made somewhere in the region of £30-35m and at least they have the benefit of automatically qualifying for the Champions League.

"It is a blow for Celtic. If you look at their share price today, it is down about 4-5%, reflecting that impact on future revenues."

Celtic charged £44 more for an adult four-match Champions League package two years ago than they did for the subsequent Europa League campaign. The difference in hospitality packages was even greater.

O'Neill spoke about transfer targets having to be reassessed in the wake of the defeat and Maguire pointed out that the club will likely lose out on sponsor bonuses, too.

"Celtic's fans will buy tickets whether it's Real Madrid or Raith Rovers, but in terms of the prices that can be charged - especially for corporate and hospitality - it's a licence to name your own price when big European clubs come to town."

Gerry : Callum McGregor says we'll now see what people are made of. Bit late. Should have said that after we gifted LASK their first goal. We are not a Champions League club. Simple. The board are a shambles and responsible for the club's failures again and again.

Eamonn : Shocking but not surprised. The squad is the accumulation of four or five disastrous windows. Four recent signings weren't going to fix that.

Martin : We are a club that have a board that wait until we get into the Champions League before spending any meaningful cash when we actually need a board that spends meaningful cash to ensure we have the best possible chance of negotiating these horrible qualifiers. Celtic were dead on their feet at the end - one of the worst results and performances in our modern history.

Patrick : Viljami Sinisalo is the only player who showed up, everyone else was a passenger. Reo Hatate and Luke McCowan should be kicked out the door. Another year, another wasted effort. What a terrible loss. The fans deserve better - the players, the board, the club are fortunate to be where they are. Odds on Martin O'Neill gone by Christmas?

Danny : Heartbreaking loss. Players didn't show up. Sinisalo was great, but our lack of depth and quality was harshly exposed. We scored some screamers last week and got away with a couple. Reality came back to bite us. Credit to LASK.

Paul : Fell short again. Playing like that, it's probably best we're not in the Champions League. McCowan should never get another game for Celtic. Sebastian Tounekti, Yang Hyun-jun and Anthony Ralston should be told to find another club. Martin O'Neill needs to take his share of the blame for this. Team didn't know whether to go for it or defend.

What are wider consequences for Scottish game?

Scotland being ranked as high as ninth in Uefa's coefficient table seems a world away right now. What might surprise many is that it was between 2021 and 2023.

This coefficient table determines how many places each country gets in the three European competitions.

With that ninth place came a guaranteed place in the Champions League proper for the Premiership champions, and the runners-up only had two qualifying rounds to navigate in the same competition.

But such has been the sharp decline since then that Scotland are now 18th, and this season's title winners will start in the second qualifying round of the Champions League, with the runners-up in the Conference League.

Celtic's capitulation at the hands of LASK underlined that decline. But it is not terminal for the country's position in the coefficient table.

When Celtic made the Champions League knockout play-off round in 2024-25, they scored 17.70 points. Yet Rangers scored more points - 19.750 - by reaching the last 16 of the Europa League.

So, with Celtic now in the Europa League, it can still be a positive.

In the live coefficient table - taking into account this season - Scotland have already dropped to 19th and there is no danger of losing further places.

But Scotland's hopes of climbing back up would be damaged if Rangers, Hibernian and Motherwell fail to make it through to the Conference League on Thursday.

Returning to the top 15 should be the immediate aim, as that gets the runners-up back into the Champions League.

articles.title: Cardiff seal signing of West Brom defender Bielik
articles.summary: Cardiff City have completed the signing of defender Krystian Bielik from Championship rivals West Bromwich Albion.
articles.body:
Cardiff City have completed the signing of centre-half Krystian Bielik from Championship rivals West Bromwich Albion on a permanent deal.

Bielik has signed a three-year contract with the Bluebirds and joined for an undisclosed fee.

"I'm very excited, I'm finally here and I couldn't be happier," he told the club's official website.

"I'm looking forward to starting with the team as soon as possible and focusing on the first game."

The 28-year-old made 17 Championship appearances for the Baggies last season as they finished 21st, narrowly avoiding relegation to League One.

The experienced defender - who can also operate as a defensive midfielder - joined Arsenal from Legia Warsaw in 2015 and had spells with Birmingham City, Walsall, Charlton Athletic and Derby County prior to joining West Brom last summer.

Bielik is Cardiff's fourth senior summer recruit following the arrivals of goalkeeper Nathan Trott , midfielder Jack Moylan and left-back Calum Scanlon , who has returned to the Welsh capital on loan from Liverpool .

"I've played a few times against Cardiff City, and it's never been an easy place to come to," Bielik added.

"It's always got a great atmosphere, so it will be a pleasure to be here playing for this club.

"I'm ready, fit and healthy, and can't wait to start with the team tomorrow and prepare for the big game on Saturday."

Poland international Bielik is a welcome addition for the Bluebirds, who are currently without a fit central defender in their ranks.

Will Fish , Dylan Lawlor, Calum Chambers and Gabriel Osho are all currently injured, although the latter is thought to be close to a return to action.

The Bluebirds gave a debut to 15-year-old defender Noah Anyadike - who became the youngest player in EFL Cup history - during their 2-1 loss against Norwich City in the second round on Tuesday night.

Bielik is in contention to make his Cardiff debut when they host Chris Wilder's Sheffield United on Saturday (15:00 BST).

articles.title: Report: Nottingham Forest set to move for Brazilian youngster
articles.summary: Nottingham Forest Transfer Latest: Liam Delap Nears £45m Move as Andre Talks Gather PaceNottingham Forest look to be accelerating through a decisive stretch...
articles.body:
Nottingham Forest Transfer Latest: Liam Delap Nears £45m Move as Andre Talks Gather Pace

Nottingham Forest look to be accelerating through a decisive stretch of the summer window, with a major move for Liam Delap edging towards completion and fresh talks under way for Corinthians midfielder Andre. In a market that has already produced plenty of noise across the Premier League, Forest's business feels particularly significant because it speaks to squad building with purpose, age profile and resale value all in view.

According to the Mail , Forest and Chelsea are closing on a £45 million deal for Delap, with a verbal agreement in place and a medical expected within the next 24 hours. Alongside that, Forest are also in talks over a £13.6 million move for Andre, the highly rated Corinthians midfielder who has attracted attention beyond Brazil after a rapid rise over the past year.

For a club seeking to push forward under Oliver Glasner, these are the sort of moves that reveal intent. Forest are not simply looking for squad fillers or short-term patches, they are targeting players who can improve the first XI, raise athletic levels and alter the shape of the side over the next few seasons.

Liam Delap transfer points to serious Forest ambition

The Delap development is the headline item, and with good reason. A £45 million outlay for a 23-year-old striker is a serious statement from Forest, particularly when the market for centre-forwards has become so inflated. Clubs across Europe are fighting for forwards with power, pace and room to develop, and Forest appear ready to commit heavily to one they believe can lead the line.

The report states that talks intensified on Monday following Chelsea's game at Fulham , and that the deal is now close. If the medical proceeds as expected, Forest will be adding a striker whose game is built around direct running, physical presence and aggression in central areas. Those qualities can transform the attacking structure of a side, especially one that wants to attack quicker, pin defenders back and threaten transitions more regularly.

What makes this move compelling is the broader football logic behind it. Delap offers more than a body in the box. He can stretch teams vertically, battle with centre-halves and create the kind of chaos that opens spaces for wide forwards and attacking midfielders. For a manager who values intensity and front-foot football, that profile has obvious appeal.

There is pressure that comes with a fee of this size, of course. Every touch, every missed chance and every run of form will be weighed against the £45 million figure. Yet that is the reality of the modern market, and if Forest believe Delap is ready to become a leading Premier League striker, this is the stage at which bold clubs have to move.

Andre could reshape Forest midfield after Elliot Anderson sale

The second strand of the story may prove equally important over time. Forest are in talks to sign Andre from Corinthians for £13.6 million, a deal that looks sharp in value terms when measured against the premiums attached to young midfielders in Europe. The 20-year-old has only been in the Brazilian top flight for a year, yet his reputation has advanced quickly enough to draw serious interest.

The Mail reports that AC Milan tried to sign him in January, while Crystal Palace have also been watching him. That level of competition matters. It suggests Forest are not acting on a whim, but targeting a player with a growing cross-market reputation.

Midfield has clearly been an area of focus since the sale of Elliot Anderson to Manchester City . The article notes Forest have also made offers for Lucas Bergvall at Tottenham Hotspur and Tijjani Reijnders , who has since moved from City to Al Qadsiah. That alone tells you the recruitment team are trying to land a certain type of player, one with mobility, technical security and the ability to cover ground in modern Premier League midfields.

Andre appears to fit that mould. Younger South American midfielders often bring a blend of bravery on the ball and competitive edge without it, and those attributes can translate very well if the adaptation process is managed properly. If Forest can conclude this deal, they would be adding a player whose value could rise sharply in England if he settles quickly.

It would also ease some of the concern around succession planning in midfield. The Premier League now demands depth, pace and tactical intelligence in the engine room, and clubs that fail to refresh there tend to find themselves overrun over the course of a season.

From a Nottingham Forest point of view, this report is the sort of update that gets supporters leaning forward rather than sitting back. Delap for £45 million is a huge call, but it is also the kind of call fans have wanted to see when there is a chance to bring in a proper focal point up front. Forest have often looked like a side in need of more force and certainty in the final third, and Delap sounds like a signing built to change that quickly.

Andre is the one that really sparks curiosity as well. Forest supporters have seen enough transfer windows to know that buying younger talent from abroad can go either way, but if the club genuinely believes he is one of the best emerging midfielders in Brazil, then £13.6 million could end up looking very smart. Replacing quality in midfield is vital after selling Elliot Anderson, and the fact the club have been looking at multiple technical midfielders suggests there is a real plan.

articles.title: Crystal Palace attempt to hijack Aston Villa's move for defender Joel Ordonez
articles.summary: Crystal Palace have had Club Brugge defender Joel Ordonez as a long-term target, while Villa made a move after struggling to agree a fee for Taylor Harwood-Bellis.
articles.body:
Crystal Palace are attempting to hijack Aston Villa 's move for Club Brugge defender Joel Ordonez.

Villa launched a move for the Ecuador international after failing to agree a fee with Southampton for Taylor Harwood-Bellis.

But Palace have now opened talks with the Belgian side over a move for Ordonez, who is viewed as a long-term target by the Selhurst Park club.

Palace have accelerated their efforts to sign a new centre-back after Chadi Riad was stretchered off against Everton on Saturday.

They completed a deal to sign Axel Disasi on loan on Wednesday but want to add another centre-back to the squad.

Villa have been working on a deal for the 22-year-old in recent days.

The Midlands side, who sold key centre-back Ezri Konsa to Arsenal last week, had targeted a move for Harwood-Bellis, 24, but there is understood to be a significant gap in valuation between the two clubs which saw Villa step up their interest in Ordonez.

Villa remain interested in Harwood-Bellis but would need to reach a deal worth a minimum of £25m to have any chance of reviving the deal for the defender.

The Belgian side value Ordonez at £40m with discussions ongoing.

Ordonez has missed the start of the new season with a fractured metatarsal, but played 46 games last season for Brugge.

After graduating from Brugge's youth ranks, he has played 128 times for the Belgian side, scoring seven times.

Ordonez represented Ecuador at this summer's World Cup, missing just one game before his country were eliminated by Mexico in the round of 32.

Palace have made six signings so far this summer, among them winger Dwight McNeil and centre-back Takehiro Tomiyasu.

articles.title: Transfer interest in Nicolas Raskin 'stepped up' as Rangers near Kim Min-su signing
articles.summary: Nicolas Raskin could be on his way out of Rangers, having not travelled to Jablonec for the club's Conference League play-off second leg, while the club are close to signing Kim Min-su from Girona.
articles.body:
Nicolas Raskin could be on his way out of Rangers, having not travelled to Jablonec for the Conference League play-off second leg, while the club are close to signing Girona's Kim Min-su.

Belgium international Raskin, 25, has been linked with Fenerbahce in recent days and, although manager Derek McInnes did not go into detail regarding the interest in him, Rangers are preparing for life without the midfielder.

While Raskin's three-and-a-half-year stint at Ibrox looks like coming to an end, winger Kim could be their 12th summer signing.

"Nico hasn't travelled, nothing to do with injury or anything like that, just the potential of a transfer," said McInnes, whose side lead Jablonec 1-0.

"I just think we're so late in the window, maybe it's something the club's looking at.

"So, he's trained this morning but he's been left back in Glasgow.

"When I came into the job, it was quite clear that there was maybe going to be an opportunity for Nico elsewhere. There's been plenty of interest in him. We believe that interest has stepped up over the last couple of days.

"So, something may or may not happen. If Nico stays beyond the window, then it would be great to work with him, but if he doesn't, we wish him well."

Winger Kim, 20, was expected in Glasgow for a medical and the South Korean looks like being the latest addition to McInnes' squad.

"We're close to certainly doing one," McInnes explained. "Min-su is obviously one that we've been really active on.

"We're not in a position where we can announce anything at the minute but it wouldn't be a million miles away to suggest that hopefully that one happens for us.

"We're still working on one or two other things. The sooner we get them in, the better, but the club are working hard to try and deliver the players that we require for the season ahead."

articles.title: El Real Madrid echa la red en el Granada
articles.standfirst: El conjunto blanco tendría muy avanzadas las llegadas de Oscar y Zinebi
articles.summary: El conjunto blanco tendría muy avanzadas las llegada de Oscar y Zinebi
articles.body: El Granada tiene entre manos una hornada de jóvenes talentos que no ha pasado desapercibida para clubes de primer nivel como el Real Madrid, que está dispuesto a pescar en el caladero rojiblanco y ya tendría encarrilada la contratación de Oscar y Zinebi, dos de los futbolistas con más proyección del conjunto andaluz. El club blanco ya puso al central ghanés en su radar durante el pasado mercado invernal, pero las altas pretensiones económicas del Granada aplacaron el interés de los del Bernabéu, que ahora vuelven a la carga con una operación que podría cerrarse en una cifra por debajo de los tres millones de euros, una cantidad muy alejada de los 10 millones que marca la cláusula de rescisión del defensor. Con contrato hasta 2028 con el conjunto nazarí, la idea del Granada era cerrar la renovación de Oscar, otorgándole ficha del primer y mejorando sus emolumentos, pero las negociaciones no han sido del todo positivas, por lo que sacar tajada con una posible venta se ha convertido en una solución beneficiosa para todas las partes. Además de la incorporación de Oscar para su filial, el Madrid también estaría ultimando la llegada de Rayan Zinebi, atacante marroquí del conjunto rojiblanco que ha vivido una progresión meteórica en los últimos meses, pasando del juvenil al primer equipo, con el que ya debutó la pasada temporada. Si nada se tuerce, el acuerdo se cerraría con una cesión a la que se añadiría una opción de compra por dos millones de euros. Zinebi, que estos días está disputando con la selección marroquí sub 20 los Juegos Mediterráneos, habría recibido permiso días atrás para viajar a Madrid y pasar los reconocimientos médicos previos a estampar su firma como nuevo jugador del conjunto blanco.

articles.title: 'Tensión' entre Dembélé y Luis Enrique
articles.standfirst: L'Équipe desvela un pequeño roce en el descanso del partido ante el Rennes en el que el galo se quedó en vestuarios
articles.summary: L'Équipe desvela un pequeño roce en el descanso del partido ante el Rennes en el que el galo se quedó en vestuarios
articles.body: Ousmane Dembélé nunca ha ocultado que tiene mucho que agradecerle a Luis Enrique. Fue el entrenador que cambió por completo su carrera hasta llevarlo a conquistar el Balón de Oro en 2025. Sin embargo, también es una relación que ha pasado por ciertos momentos de tensión... como ocurrió el pasado fin de semana en el vestuario del Roazhon Park. Con 2-0 abajo en el primer partido de la Ligue 1 contra el Rennes, el cual no pudo disputarse en el Parque de los Príncipes debido al deficiente estado del terreno de juego, Luis Enrique sorprendió retirando al descanso, además de a Kvaratskhelia, a Ousmane Dembélé para dar entrada a un Ferran Torres que acabó rescatando un empate en su debut con un doblete. "El fútbol es así. El Paris Saint-Germain no ha ganado nada, nada. Si piensas en lo que has ganado, no vas a ganar nada. Lo más importante para mí es que no hay crédito: tienes que demostrar cada día, en cada entrenamiento, en cada partido, que estás listo. Si no, es fácil acomodarse. No. Buscamos ganar todo el tiempo, y para eso tienes que salir de tu zona de confort. ¿Está claro?", dijo Luis Enrique después del partido. L'Équipe ha desvelado que se vivieron momentos de tensión en el vestuario entre Luis Enrique y Dembélé. Al final del encuentro, el francés fue el último jugador del PSG en subirse al autobús y, según ha desvelado L'Équipe, fue debido a que Ousmane se quedó esperando al técnico asturiano. El prestigioso medio francés informa que, si bien arrancó de forma "un poco tensa, la conversación permitió encontrar una solución". Sin apenas descanso tras las disputa del Mundial, Dembélé y Luis Enrique acordaron ampliar las vacaciones y no se reintegrará con el grupo hasta el próximo lunes. Es decir, no estará presente en el duelo de este fin de semana contra el Lille.

articles.title: Uno a uno del Real Madrid contra la Real Sociedad: valoración y comentarios
articles.standfirst: Análisis de la actuación de los jugadores y de Mourinho
articles.summary: Análisis de la actuación de los jugadores y de Mourinho
articles.body: Al Madrid se le escapó en la última jugada del primer tiempo la ventaja en el marcador que tanto le costó conseguir pese al dominio y la mayor insistencia en las inmediaciones del área de Remiro. Con Valverde y Bellingham empujando y Vinicius y Mbappé intimidando, el Madrid se trabajó adelantarse en el marcador y lo consiguió con un gran gol de Kylian. Pero un arreón de la Real en una acción sin aparente peligro le sirvió para devolver las tablas al marcador. PRIMERA PARTE: Gran parada con los pies en un mano a mano ante Oyarzabal. Bien colocado en una espectacular volea de Sergio Gómez que se marchó fuer por poco y que hubiese parado de ir a puerta. No puede hacer nada en el tiro ajustado de Sucic del empate a uno. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 8 PRIMERA PARTE: Sin grandes recursos ofensivos para sorprender por su banda y con alguna dificultada en la salida de balón. Le han ganado la espalda en alguna ocasión. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 5 PRIMERA PARTE: Muy sólido y transmitiendo seguridad hasta el gol de la Real, donde no estuvo todo lo contundente que debería en una acción con Ochieng previa al empate. Ahí se dejó el notable que firmaba en el primer tiempo. Buena acción defensiva para cortar un ataque de Kubo y otra buena salida al corte ante Ochieng. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 6 PRIMERA PARTE: Muy cerca siempre de los medios para asociarse en la circulación del balón. Atento y rápido en las coberturas. Se le marcha largo un desplazamiento que habilitaba a Dumfries para una buena contra. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 6 PRIMERA PARTE: Demasiado tráfico en su banda para lucirse en ataque. No llegó a tiempo para defender el disparo de Sucic tras un rechace que supuso el 1-1. Se le marcha muy desviado una opción de centro al área. Ve una amarilla en el 10' que condiciona su partido. Sustituido al descanso precisamente por este motivo y dejando su sitio a Cucurella. NOTA FINAL: 5 PRIMERA PARTE: Espectacular su conducción rompiendo líneas para habilitar a Mbappé en el gol del Madrid. En 'plan Tchouaméni', pendiente de dar equilibrio al equipo en todo momento. Buen robo de balón que generó una gran ocasión de Vinicius. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 7 PRIMERA PARTE: De menos a más. Intentando poner orden al juego del Madrid. Por momentos participativo en posesiones largas del Madrid en busca de resquicios por los que romper el orden de la Real. Intermitente. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 5 PRIMERA PARTE: Dando sensación de estar pletórico en lo físico y sin perder la chispa que recuperó en el Mundial. Intenso, agresivo, apareciendo por todas partes y jugando con claridad y precisión. Apareciendo con mucho peligro en la frontal del área y fabricando buenas ocasiones de Mbappé y Vini. Pidió una falta clarísima en la frontal del área que le niega Busquets Ferrer. Provoca una amarilla a Yangel Herrera. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 8 PRIMERA PARTE: Gris. Sin mucha posibilidad de sacar brillo a su calidad en los metros finales. Acompañó una carrera de Mbappé y estuvo en disposición de recibir al segundo palo, pero el francés se la jugó y disparó a puerta. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 5 PRIMERA PARTE: Fulminó las dudas que estaba dejando su primer tiempo poniendo en la escuadra un zurdazo con el que adelantó al Madrid. Golazo marca de la casa. Antes, algo acelerado y desacertado. Protagonizó una galopada tras un pase de Vini, pero estrella su disparo en Remiro. Buen pase con el que deja a Vinicius mano a mano con Remiro. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 7 PRIMERA PARTE: Empezó insistente y en modo martillo golpeando una y otra vez con sus arrancadas a la defensa de la Real. Se le marcha ligeramente alto un potente zurdazo desde la frontal. Gran pase en profundidad a Mbappé que genera la primera ocasión clara del Madrid. Mano a mano con Remiro que finaliza mal y le detiene el portero realista con el pie. Se fue diluyendo con el paso de los minutos. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 6 PRIMER TIEMPO: Dominio del Madrid, que por momentos protagonizó minutos de un claro acoso a la Real. Le costó encontrar el gol al equipo, que luego 'regaló' el empate justo antes del descanso. NOTA DEL PRIMER TIEMPO: 6

articles.title: El Andorra ficha a Jesús Owono a coste cero por dos temporadas con opción a dos más

articles.summary: El recuerdo que dejó el curso pasado, cedido, fue más que positivo, disputando 21 duelos y dejando la portería a cero en seis de ellos
articles.body: Sin que el Alavés recibiera otras ofertas y con ganas de volver, Jesús Owono es oficialmente nuevo jugador del Andorra. Después de hacerlo la pasada temporada en calidad de cedido procedente del mismo conjunto vasco, ahora aterriza libre en el club tricolor y firma por dos cursos con dos más opcionales. Este año no ha sido convocado por Quique Sánchez Flores en ninguno de los dos partidos de Primera división que el Alavés ha disputado, puesto que han encontrado en Adrián Rodríguez el relevo de Antonio Sivera. El guardameta ecuatoguineano aún no se ha puesto a las órdenes de Carles Manso, pero lo hará pronto. En todo caso, el recuerdo que dejó en el Nou Estadi de la FAF el curso pasado fue más que positivo, disputando 21 duelos y dejando la portería a cero en 6 de ellos. Se jugará el lugar bajo palos con Nico Ratti y Pau López, este último siendo el escogido en las dos primeras jornadas ligueras de este año.

articles.title: UEFA set to end FIFA boycott threat over Infantino’s $20bn investor plan
articles.summary: UEFA set to end threat of FIFA events boycott after assurances over Gianni Infantino’s failed World Cup investor plan.
articles.body:
European football body UEFA is set to formally withdraw its threat to boycott FIFA competitions after receiving assurances that FIFA President Gianni Infantino’s failed World Cup selloff plan will not be revived.

UEFA’s member federations are meeting Thursday in Monaco ahead of the Champions League draw, where they are expected to end the boycott threat, a person familiar with the proposal told The Associated Press news agency on Wednesday.

The person spoke on condition of anonymity because the agenda of the closed-door meeting was confidential.

Ruling out a boycott will clear six European teams to continue preparing for the FIFA Under-20 Women’s World Cup that kicks off September 5 in Poland.

France and Spain named their squads last week for the 24-nation tournament that risked becoming an unwanted battleground in European football’s pushback against Infantino’s private investor plan. England, Italy, Portugal and host Poland also will play. The United States, Brazil and Argentina also are in the lineup.

FIFA welcomed the update from UEFA in a statement, adding it “strongly believes that football has the power to unite, even in challenging circumstances, and looks forward to welcoming all teams and players to Poland”.

Infantino infuriated football leaders worldwide last month when his plan for a $20bn subsidiary controlling FIFA commercial rights – including the World Cup – was revealed by British daily The Times.

The spinoff was to be 20 percent owned by investors led by a New York fund created by Joshua Kushner, whose initial money was to pay offers of $20m to each of FIFA’s 211 member federations. Kushner is the brother of Jared Kushner, US President Donald Trump’s son-in-law. The FIFA member federations were given a mid-September deadline to accept.

FIFA President Infantino dropped his proposal within four days amid a furious backlash led by UEFA, including the boycott threat, with support from the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) and the Confederation of North, Central American and Caribbean Association Football (CONCACAF). The furore was fuelled by criticism of the plan and of Infantino from senior FIFA officials.

UEFA then said it wanted assurances the spinoff, to be called FIFA Forward Enterprise, would not be presented in a different form. That assurance was now received, the person told the AP.

The European football body said on August 1 that it had no confidence in Infantino’s leadership in a clear signal that it would try to stop his re-election in March next year.

The next set of FIFA competition games in Europe after the under-20s event is qualifying playoffs for the 2027 Women’s World Cup, scheduled for October 9-13. Qualifying games for the next men’s World Cup do not start until 2029.

FIFA previously set a November 18 deadline for candidates to enter the presidential contest, four months ahead of the vote by 211 member federations in Rabat, Morocco.

Infantino had seemed sure to be re-elected unopposed for a fourth and final term in office through 2031 until the turmoil created by his investor plan.

The 55 UEFA member federations are attending the meeting in Monaco four weeks after they united in an online call to agree to the threatened boycott.

articles.title: El Málaga renovará a Pablo Arriaza hasta 2028
articles.standfirst: El canterano saldrá cedido y dejará libre otra ficha
articles.summary: El canterano saldrá cedido y dejará libre otra ficha
articles.body: El Málaga empieza a despejar otra de las incógnitas que tenía pendientes en este mercado. Pablo Arriaza, capitán del Atlético Malagueño durante la temporada del ascenso, continuará vinculado al conjunto blanquiazul, aunque lo hará lejos de La Rosaleda. Según ha podido saber Radio MARCA Málaga, el canterano renovará por una temporada y saldrá cedido. La operación responde también a uno de los objetivos que había marcado Juanfran Funes, partidario de mantener el control sobre un futbolista al que considera con margen de crecimiento. La renovación todavía necesita cerrar algunos detalles, pero las conversaciones se encuentran muy avanzadas y Arriaza ampliará su relación contractual con el Málaga hasta junio de 2028. El siguiente paso será encontrarle un destino. La prioridad del jugador es continuar su formación en Primera RFEF, aunque a estas alturas todavía no existe un club que haya tomado ventaja para hacerse con sus servicios. El mercado de la categoría ya está muy avanzado y buena parte de las plantillas tienen prácticamente definida su composición. Arriaza ha tenido protagonismo durante la pretemporada. El centrocampista ha sido titular en buena parte de los amistosos y ha lucido incluso el dorsal 2, pero en el Málaga consideran que todavía necesita dar un paso más antes de afrontar el salto a Primera División. La cesión aparece así como la fórmula elegida para que pueda acumular minutos y experiencia en una categoría exigente. Con 22 años, Pablo Arriaza es uno de los futbolistas que ha ido creciendo desde las categorías inferiores del club. Formado en el CD Tiro Pichón, el centrocampista se convirtió el pasado curso en una pieza importante del Atlético Malagueño, con 27 encuentros disputados en el Grupo IV de Segunda Federación. Además, tuvo presencia habitual en los entrenamientos del primer equipo y llegó a estrenarse oficialmente con el Málaga. Su debut llegó de la mano de Juanfran Funes en la Copa del Rey frente al Talavera. Arriaza disputó el partido completo, aunque el Málaga terminó cayendo por 2-1 y quedó eliminado del torneo. El técnico ya había explicado durante el verano la hoja de ruta que manejaba el club con el canterano. Funes destacó entonces que Arriaza era "un valor importante para el club" y puso como referencia los casos de Larrubia y Dani Lorenzo, futbolistas que también tuvieron que buscar minutos lejos del Málaga para continuar con su evolución. "Tenemos que intentar elegir el mejor camino para él. Es patrimonio de nuestro club y hay que cuidarlo", apuntó el entrenador.

articles.title: LSU Reportedly Abstained from Voting on SEC Rule Change Banning NFL Players From Returning to School
articles.summary: LSU was reportedly not part of the SEC's formal vote to finalize penalties for member schools who sign professional athletes.
articles.body:
LSU was reportedly not part of the SEC's formal vote to finalize penalties for member schools who sign professional athletes.

ESPN's Pete Thamel reported LSU abstained from Wednesday's formal presidential vote confirming penalties for programs violating the SEC's new rule against pro players returning to the conference.

LSU was part of the SEC's initial 16-0 vote to institute the rule, according to Thamel.

The SEC announced Tuesday the league would enforce penalties against member schools that roster athletes drafted or signed by NFL, NBA or WNBA teams.

Penalties finalized Wedneday include a fine equal to half the sport's operating budget as well as a half-season suspension for head coaches, per CBS Sports' Matt Norlander.

Programs in violation of the new rule would also lose voting rights for SEC business matters and could receive other penalties up to the discretion of commissioner Greg Sankey, per Norlander.

The move came after the Big Ten unanimously passed a rule blocking NFL players from returning to the conference.

The Big 12 is expected to issue a similar ban on professional athletes returning to compete in their conference, per Yahoo Sports' Ross Dellenger .

Independent Notre Dame has expressed interest in a similar measure, while the ACC is also expected to discuss a ban, according to reports from Dellenger .

LSU head coach Lane Kiffin confirmed earlier this week he has recruited players seeking a fifth year of college eligibility.

CBS Sports' John Talty and Chris Hummer reported Tuesday "Kiffin and the Tigers reached out to multiple players on NFL rosters or their representation in an effort to get them to bring a lawsuit against the NCAA and return to school, per sources."

The NCAA decided in June to allow five years of eligibility for DI student-athletes starting this fall.

That led to lawsuits across the country involving players from the high school graduating class of 2022, who were not included in the rule change, campaigning for fifth-year eligibility of their own.

Some players involved in that legal action had signed with NFL teams since leaving their respective college programs.

The NFL is set to issue eligibility guidance Wednesday including a rule prohibiting clubs from signing players who returned to college the same season, per ESPN's Adam Schefter .

articles.title: Continúa la 'fuga' en el City: Nico González se marcha al Newcastle
articles.standfirst: El pivote español recala en St. James' Park por cerca de 60 millones de euros entre fijos y variables
articles.summary: El pivote español recala en St. James' Park por cerca de 60 millones de euros entre fijos y variables
articles.body: Esta temporada no se escuchará hablar castellano en el Manchester City. Pep Guardiola abandonó el banquillo tras una década; Rodri cumplió su deseo de fichar por el Barcelona; y Nico González ha completado su transferencia al Newcastle. La operación se ha cerrado en cerca de 60 millones de euros entre fijos y variables. "Estoy muy contento de estar aquí en este increíble club. Solo he escuchado cosas maravillosas sobre el club y la ciudad, así que estoy muy emocionado de vivir aquí y ser parte de este proyecto", fueron las primeras palabras del nuevo '6' de las 'urracas'. De hecho, el fichaje fue anunciado minutos antes de arrancar el duelo de Carabao Cup en St. James' Park ante el West Brom. Fichado en enero de 2025 como 'parche' ante la grave lesión de Rodri tras abonar la cláusula de 60 millones que tenía en su contrato con el Oporto, se marcha año y medio después con 59 partidos a sus espaldas y dos títulos: la FA Cup y la Carabao Cup. Ambos, conquistados la temporada pasada. "Hemos trabajado pacientemente en este traspaso durante varias semanas. Era el que queríamos y estamos encantados de darle la bienvenida a Nico al Newcastle United esta noche. Era un objetivo ambicioso, pero tras nuestras conversaciones, estaba muy ilusionado por unirse a este club", dijo Ross Wilson, director deportivo del Newcastle. El Newcastle, necesitado por sumar integrantes a su sala de máquinas tras verse obligado a vender a Sandro Tonali y Bruno Guimaraes, llega para ser un hombre capital para Matthias Jaissle desde el primer momento. "Estoy muy contento de ver a Nico convertirse en jugador del Newcastle United. Aporta una gran calidad y una experiencia de élite en una zona clave del campo". Con los cerca de 60 millones de euros ingresados por la venta de Nico González, el Manchester City se encuentra ahora en posición para lanzar una ofensiva final para hacerse con los servicios de Enzo Fernández. La operación apunta a a irse, en caso de llevarse a cabo, por encima de los 140 'kilos'. Es un deseo expreso en Enzo Maresca para afrontar el 'post' Rodri con ciertas garantías junto a Bouaddi y Elliot Anderson.

articles.title: Mourinho se reencuentra con el Bernabéu 4.834 días después
articles.standfirst: El luso fue recibido con aplausos y una ovación cuando se mencionó su nombre por megafonía
articles.summary: El luso fue recibido con aplausos y una ovación cuando se mencionó su nombre por megafonía
articles.body: Fue un 1 de junio de 2013 cuando Mourinho se sentó por última vez en el banquillo del Real Madrid. Han tenido que pasar 4.834 días (más de 13 años) para que The Special One regrese a la que fue su casa durante tres temporadas en las que cosechó tres títulos. El contraste es más que evidente. Aquella tarde Mourinho fue el principal objeto de debate entre una afición blanca dividida. El luso solo contó con el caluroso apoyo de la grada de Ultras Sur (disuelta meses después por Florentino), que le arropó en su adiós con el mensaje "Mourinho, gracias por luchar contra viento y marea". Sobre el verde también. Mourinho dispuso un once formado por Jesús Fernández, Callejón, Albiol, Carvalho, Arbeloa, Essien, Modric, Di María, Ozil, Benzema e Higuaín. Las figuras de Casillas, Cristiano Ronaldo y Pepe se quedaron fuera de la convocatoria en un último partido en el que la fractura del técnico con el vestuario era evidente. Todo eso ya es agua pasada porque Mourinho fue recibido con una atronadora ovación y aplausos por parte del Santiago Bernabéu cuando fue nombrado en la megafonía. Un reencuentro en el que el luso no reclamó el protagonismo. "No quiero que el Bernabéu me reciba de un modo particular, quiero que reciba al equipo como su equipo, como su pasión", recalcó en la previa. Fue en el minuto uno de partido cuando la grada de animación se volvió a acordar de él coreando su nombre con el propio Mou todavía acomodándose en el banquillo blanco. Corrieron minutos tranquilos hasta el minuto nueve, en el que el luso salió al área técnica a protestar la amarilla a Carreras. La primera parte no estuvo exenta de pitos, una tónica que se repitió demasiadas veces la temporada pasada. El Madrid estaba concediendo de más y el sonido de viento proliferó por parte de la grada del Bernabeú. Mourinho, consciente de que no estaban saliendo las cosas, puso a calentar a Cucurella, Espí, Brahim, Trent y Camavinga. Poco duró la tormenta, ya que una carrera de Valverde acabó en gol de Mbappé para el 1-0.

articles.title: El Valencia hace oficial el fichaje de Arnau Martínez hasta 2031
articles.standfirst: El lateral derecho se pone a las órdenes de Corberán y podría debutar el domingo en Riazor ante el Deportivo
articles.summary: El lateral derecho se pone a las órdenes de Corberán y podría debutar el domingo en Riazor ante el Deportivo
articles.body: El Valencia anunció oficialmente el fichaje de Arnau Martínez que llega procedente del Girona y firma un contrato de cinco temporadas, hasta junio de 2031. El acuerdo entre ambas entidades se cerró por cinco millones de euros fijos, más uno en variables, además del 10% de la plusvalía de una futura venta del jugador. El lateral derecho era una de las prioridades de Carlos Corberán para reforzar la plantilla antes del cierre del mercado. Su versatilidad ha sido uno de los aspectos más valorados por el cuerpo técnico, ya que además de ocupar el carril derecho de la defensa puede actuar como central en el perfil diestro. De hecho, fue la lesión de De Haas (junto con la ya conocida de Copete de la temporada pasada, más las dudas con el rendimiento de Diakhaby) la que provocó la oferta final del Valencia. Formado en las categorías inferiores del Barcelona, Arnau Martínez desarrolló posteriormente toda su carrera profesional en el Girona, donde llegó a consolidarse como una pieza importante del primer equipo. Durante las últimas temporadas acumuló experiencia tanto en Primera división como en competiciones europeas, convirtiéndose en uno de los futbolistas más cotizados de la plantilla gerundense. La voluntad del jugador de vestir la camiseta del Valencia resultó determinante para desbloquear una negociación que atravesó distintos momentos de dificultad durante el verano. El propio futbolista reconoció antes de formalizar su fichaje que había hecho "todo lo posible" para que la operación pudiera completarse con éxito. Con el anuncio oficial, Arnau Martínez queda ya a disposición de Carlos Corberán y está previsto que este jueves complete su primera sesión de entrenamiento junto a sus nuevos compañeros en la Ciudad Deportiva de Paterna. El objetivo es que entre cuanto antes en la dinámica del equipo y pueda optar a una convocatoria para el próximo compromiso liguero frente al Deportivo en Riazor.

articles.title: Brentford transfer news: West Ham accept £40m bid for El Hadji Malick Diouf
articles.summary: El Hadji Malick Diouf is cleared to have a medical with Brentford after West Ham accept a £40m bid for the Senegal defender.
articles.body:
Brentford have reached a verbal agreement with West Ham to sign defender El Hadji Malick Diouf in a deal worth up to £40m.

The 21-year-old Senegal left-back would cost an initial £35m, with a further £5m in add-ons.

West Ham have accepted Brentford 's bid and Diouf has been cleared to have a medical.

Diouf played in West Ham's Championship opener against Burnley, but has been excluded from the matchday squads of the Hammers' past two games.

He has been the Bees' priority defensive target in this transfer window, but discussions had stalled this summer before being reopened this week.

Diouf would return to the Premier League after suffering relegation with the Hammers last season.

And his sale would represent a big profit for West Ham on a player they paid £19m for a year ago to join from Slavia Prague.

Diouf played 34 times for West Ham last season, providing five assists.

He could become Brentford 's fifth summer signing of the summer after the arrivals of striker Callum Wilson, midfielder Mamadou Sangare, centre-back Jannik Schuster and winger Jaidon Anthony.

After breaking into the Senegal side last year, Diouf played four times at the World Cup this summer.

While West Ham were relegated after finishing 18th last season, Brentford enjoyed an excellent campaign under Keith Andrews, finishing ninth and just missing out on European football on goal difference.

Brentford began their season on Saturday with a 3-0 win over Tottenham Hotspur , and play Leeds on Sunday in their next league game.

articles.title: El Bernabéu vibra con Cucurella
articles.standfirst: Homenaje del Real Madrid a su campeón del mundo, y también a Mikel Oyarzabal
articles.summary: Homenaje del Real Madrid a su campeón del mundo, y también a Mikel Oyarzabal
articles.body: Marc Cucurella no estuvo en el once elegido por Jose Mourinho para el estreno liguero del equipo blanco en su estadio. Pero su puesta de largo en el Bernabéu como jugador del Real Madrid la recordará siempre por un motivo muy especial: el tributo que le rindió su nuevo estadio por haberse proclamado campeón del mundo el pasado 19 de julio en New Jersey. El lateral del Real Madrid recibió el cariño de la afición madridista con la presencia de la Copa del Mundo en el templo madridista. Cucurella se convirtió en jugador del Real Madrid horas antes del estreno de España en la Copa del Mundo. En los anales de la competición queda como jugador del Chelsea, pero el club blanco no ha dudado en homenajear a uno de los 26 héroes de la selección. Colocada la Copa del Mundo en un pedestal a pie de campo, Cucurella fue anunciado después del sorteo de campos. "Esta noche el estadio Santiago Bernabéu y todo el madridismo rinden homenaje al jugador del Real Madrid campeón del mundo, Marc Cucurella". Una imponente ovación se apoderó del estadio, que por primera coreó el "Cucurella, Cucurella". En ese contexto, la entidad madridista sumó su reconocimiento al jugador de la Real Sociedad que también formó parte del grupo elegido por Luis de la Fuente. Mikel Oyarzabal, pieza tan indiscutible para el seleccionador como Cucurella, también disfrutó del calor del Bernabéu como agradecimiento a la segunda estrella cosida a la camiseta de España. La ovación se multiplicó al juntarse los dos campeones del mundo para hacerse la foto con la joya del palmarés de ambos. La historia de Cucurella en el Bernabéu entra ahora en una nueva dimensión. Hasta ahora solo una vez había saltado al campo con la grada a su favor. Fue en marzo de 2024, en el amistoso entre España y Brasil. Ese día, con Vinicius como oponente, se adueñó del lateral zurdo de la selección, con la que ya es campeón del mundo y de Europa.

articles.title: Ohio State's New Field-Level Suites Revealed in Video, Wild Price Announced Ahead of 2026 CFB Season
articles.summary: Ohio State fans hoping to watch the No. 1 team in the country in luxury this college football season now have new options.
articles.body:
Ohio State fans hoping to watch the No. 1 team in the country in luxury this college football season now have new options.

The Buckeyes installed new premium field-level suites in the south end zone of Ohio Stadium, and they will cost $142,700 each. The suites can hold up to 12 people with eight standing-room spots, although they are still under construction ahead of the Sept. 5 home opener:

That is not the only change, as Ohio Stadium will also have new turf installed:

Ohio State announced in June 2025 it planned on installing nine field-level suites as well as 400 premium chairback seats on top of the field-level additions.

Athletic director Ross Bjork said it "marks a small key step in the ongoing modernization of Ohio Stadium—ensuring this iconic and wonderful venue continues to evolve while honoring the traditions that make it so special. We're dedicated to making every visit to the 'Shoe unforgettable, and this enhancement is another meaningful stride toward delivering the best possible game day experience."

According to the announcement, fans in the premium suites will enter their seats from the same tunnel the football team uses to get to the field. What's more, they will have access to the 1922 Club, which will feature all-inclusive food and drink.

As a result of the new installations, the Buckeyes band will move from the south end zone seating to the north end zone.

Fans who attend games in the new seating options will have the opportunity to watch a team that will once again be entering a new season with national championship expectations. With star wide receiver Jeremiah Smith and quarterback Julian Sayin returning, the Scarlet and Gray are No. 1 in the country in the Associated Press Top 25.

However, all that talent will certainly be challenged by a daunting schedule that includes road trips to Texas, Indiana, USC and Iowa, as well as home games against Oregon and Michigan.

articles.title: Los fichajes se hacen notar en el estreno del curso
articles.standfirst: Los goles de Schröder y Levels doblegan al Ajax en Duivendrecht y dejan en bandeja la fase Liga de la Champions League
articles.summary: Los goles de Schröder y Levels doblegan al Ajax en Duivendrecht y dejan en bandeja la fase Liga de la Champions League
articles.body: El Real Madrid arrancó de manera oficial la temporada 2026/27 con una victoria (0-2) ante el Ajax en la ida de la tercera ronda de la fase previa de la Champions League disputada en el De Toekomst de Duivendrecht. Los goles de Schröder y Levels dejan al conjunto blanco a un paso de clasificarse para la fase Liga de la competición, hito que deberán certificar dentro de una semana en el Alfredo Di Stéfano. Pau Quesada apostó por un once con cuatro de los seis fichajes de este verano. El partido fue un monólogo blanco desde el pitido inicial, dominando tanto la parcela física como la estratégica. Las visitantes percutieron el muro rival desde las bandas, donde Keukelaar -ex del Ajax- y Caicedo se hicieron notar constantemente. Schröder firmó la primera ocasión de peligro rematando cerca del palo un centro desde el costado zurdo de Levels. Luego fue Linda quien hizo estirarse a Liefting con un derechazo con rosca desde la frontal y Jacinto quien lo intentó aprovechando un rechace a la salida de un córner. Las visitantes intentaron sorprender a las locales con un enroque de sus extremos. Keukelaar no tardó en irse hacia adentro y probar suerte, sin ella, desde fuera del área. Llegados a la media hora de acción, Van Koppen le pegó con el alma desde fuera del área obligando a un vuelo sin motor a Frohms para evitar el gol. La respuesta fue de Lotte, cuyo disparo con la zurda desde la medialuna golpeó a una rival y se estrelló en la madera. El cántaro se rompería a tres minutos del descanso, en una falta desde la frontal que Schröder ejecutó a la perfección mandando el balón al fondo de las mallas. La entrada de Bejarano -por Caicedo- en el entreacto descontroló a un Real Madrid que sufrió dos buenas internadas de Van Koppen -notable extremo, la más incisiva de su equipo-, llegando a Frohms a salvar un mano a mano que podía haber supuesto el empate. Quesada detectó el bajón y no tardó en dar entrada a Angeldahl buscando nuevamente el control (casi) absoluto. La sueca dio pausa al duelo y sentido al correr de un balón que volvió a ser dueño de las visitantes. El segundo del Real Madrid llegó a falta de 20 minutos para el final. Levels recogió un balón en el interior del área tras varios rechaces para anotar con la diestra libre de marcas. El Ajax intentó reaccionar de inmediato con un pase desde línea de fondo de Snoeijs que no encontró rematadora, ocasión a la que respondió Schröder en una contra que finalizó con un derechazo al lateral de la red. Quesada dio oxígeno al equipo en el tramo final dando entrada a Cristóbal, Pau y Beerensteyn. En esos últimos minutos, Comendador estuvo cerca de ampliar la renta blanca con un centro-chut envenenado que acabó golpeando el travesaño. La última la tuvo Beerensteyn, que en el añadido, en una nueva contra, no supo resolver con tino después de plantarse sola ante la meta rival.

articles.title: La UEFA se reúne mañana en Mónaco para confirmar que no habrá boicot a FIFA
articles.standfirst: El organismo va a tratar el asunto junto a 35 de sus federaciones presentes en Mónaco, entre ellas la española, y emitirá después un comunicado
articles.summary: El organismo va a tratar el asunto junto a 35 de sus federaciones presentes en Mónaco, entre ellas la española, y emitirá después un comunicado
articles.body: La UEFA se reúne mañana en Mónaco, donde por la tarde tiene lugar el sorteo de la Champions, para anunciar su decisión definitiva sobre el boicot a las competiciones FIFA, que este mismo mes de noviembre tiene la Copa del Mundo femenina sub 20. Como ha trascendido a lo largo del día de hoy, el organismo que preside Aleksander Ceferin ha decidido por el momento no torpedear a la FIFA y emitirá un comunicado tras la reunión que mantendrá su Comité Ejecutivo, con 35 de sus federaciones presentes en Mónaco, entre ellas la española, y los miembros de la UEFA que forman parte del Consejo de la FIFA, para explicar con más detalle su decisión. La UEFA va a trasladar hoy su voluntad a todas las partes y lo normal es que no haya cambios. Las aspiraciones del organismo europeo son que la FIFA retire el proyecto, como ya anunció en su momento Gianni Infantino, pero lo que más le preocupa es el compromiso de FIFA de que esta propuesta quede aparcada de forma definitiva y quiere garantías en este sentido. Desde la UEFA se quiere proteger al fútbol y a las competiciones pese a las diferencias que hay ya con Infantino y que parecen ahora mismo insalvables. Por eso mismo, adoptar ahora una decisión tan drástica perjudicaría al fútbol y, en este caso, al femenino en la competición que se va a celebrar en Polonia. De hecho, se avecina un año más que movido dado que hay elecciones a la presidencia de la FIFA y es un asunto que también se va a tratar en la reunión de hoy con las Federaciones. En lo que respecta a España, cuyo presidente Rafael Louzán se encuentra ya en Mónaco, no se ha pronunciado sobre si apoyará a Infantino, inmersa en la disputa con Marruecos por albergar la final del Mundial de 2030, pese a que otras federaciones de peso como Italia, Rumania, Gales, Inglaterra, Escocia, Suecia, Albania o Croacia ya han dejado claro que apuestan por otro candidato.

articles.title: Schröder marca el primer gol oficial de la temporada del Real Madrid
articles.standfirst: La sueca, el fichaje más caro en la historia del conjunto blanco, abrió el marcador ante el Ajax
articles.summary: La sueca, el fichaje más caro en la historia del conjunto blanco, abrió el marcador ante el Ajax
articles.body: Felicia Schröder tiene sólo 19 años (no cumplirá 20 hasta el 13 de abril), pero apunta a ser una de las jugadoras a seguir esta temporada. La internacional sueca marcó el primer gol oficial del Real Madrid esta temporada, el tanto con el que su equipo se adelantó al Ajax en el estadio De Toekomst y que sirvió para encarrilar una eliminatoria que debería acabar con el conjunto blanco en la fase Liga de la Champions League. Se trata de la jugadora número 49 del Real Madrid que inscribe su nombre en la nómina de goleadoras históricas, la 28 que lo hace en la Champions League. Schröder fue anunciada como nueva jugadora del Real Madrid el 23 de junio después de un cuantioso traspaso (se estima que alrededor del millón y medio). A pesar de ser el fichaje más caro en la historia del conjunto blanco -y uno de los primeros en el ranking global-, la sueca está demostrando que no le puede la presión. "Estoy nerviosa e ilusionada por formar parte de este club", dijo en su 'presentación'. "Quiero marcar goles, ganar partidos y ojalá conseguir títulos", añadió quien llegó para ejercer de la '9' que demandaba el equipo dirigido por un Pau Quesada que le está dando minutos y confianza en sus primeros meses en la capital de España. Felicia fue titular en el primer partido oficial de la temporada del Real Madrid. Formó tridente de ataque junto a Linda Caicedo y Lotte Keukelaar, con quienes combinó a la perfección. Suyo fue el primer remate del partido, a centro lateral de Levels, y algunas de las ocasiones de peligro que generó su equipo durante todo el encuentro. La de Kalvsund, con el '12' a la espalda, recogió frutos a su esfuerzo en el umbral del descanso. Fue la encargada de ejecutar una falta en la frontal y su lanzamiento se tradujo en gol con un derechazo perfecto ante el que poco pudo hacer Liefting. Schröder, séptima sueca que juega en el Real Madrid tras Kosovare Asllani, Sofia Jakobsson, Freja Olofsson, Filippa Angeldahl, Bella Andersson y Hanna Bennison, firmó un notable partido que acabó para ella en el minuto 81 al ser relevada por Lineth Beerensteyn. Buena tarjeta de presentación, sin duda.
